description: A minimal Scala 3 library for reading and writing JSON, cross-built for JVM, Scala.js, and Scala Native.
rules: Use Scala 3 and keep the application’s existing build tool. Enable -Yretain-trees so derived parsers can read constructor defaults.
Prefer derives JsonRW for case classes and enums. Import ba.sake.tupson.{*, given} and use toJson and parseJson[T].
Missing object fields use constructor defaults before JsonRW.default. JSON null parses as None for Option fields.
Use @type as the default sum-type discriminator and @discriminator("key") to customize the field name.
Catch ParsingException to inspect the aggregated, path-aware ParseErrors.
Use tupson-config for Typesafe Config on the JVM and tupson-sttp for sttp client4 on JVM, Scala.js, and Scala Native.
